awards.title: Radiation-Tolerant Optical Inter-Satellite Link Modem
awards.abstract: Compact OISL modem for crosslink resilience under solar maximum conditions, targeting USSF SDA constellations. Phase II funds qualification testing and integration with two reference buses.

awards.title: Multi-Sensor Fusion for Tactical GEOINT Workflows
awards.abstract: Onboard fusion of EO, SAR and RF emitter data with model compression suitable for tactical edge devices. Phase II delivers a containerised reference workflow to NGA's experimental cloud.

awards.title: Zero-Trust Telemetry Integrity for Spacecraft TT&C
awards.abstract: Cryptographic provenance of telemetry from antenna to mission ops, with replay-attack hardening on both sides of the air gap. Phase II includes red-team exercise on AFRL ground testbed.

awards.title: Persistent Maritime Surveillance UAV Swarm Coordination
awards.abstract: Decentralised tasking and contested-RF resilience for VTOL fleets operating from DDG class. Phase II runs sea trials on a fleet of six air vehicles.

awards.title: Green Monopropellant for Long-Duration Orbital Transfer Vehicles
awards.abstract: Non-hydrazine monopropellant qualified for multi-month dormancy in cislunar transfer applications. Phase II matures throttling injector and completes 200-hour life test.

awards.title: High-Cadence Optical Tracking for Hypersonic Threats
awards.abstract: MWIR sensor module and tracker integration suitable for proliferated LEO architectures. Phase II includes integration onto a flight-representative satellite bus.

awards.title: Sparse Inference Accelerator for On-Orbit Edge AI
awards.abstract: Custom ASIC for activation-sparse inference at <8W draw, targeting persistent on-orbit triage of EO data. Phase II tapes out a flight-pathfinder die.

awards.title: Group 3 UAV Counter-Jamming Autonomy Stack
awards.abstract: Onboard policy for autonomous waypoint replanning under intermittent GPS/SATCOM denial. Phase II delivers flight-tested module on a Group 3 representative airframe.

awards.title: Post-Quantum TLS for Spacecraft Command Pathways
awards.abstract: FIPS-validated post-quantum command channel for COTS bus families, with fallback signing for legacy ground stations. Phase II completes interop with three commercial mission-ops platforms.

awards.title: Lunar Surface Robotic Manipulation for Cargo Offload
awards.abstract: Dexterous end-effector tested under 1/6 g for cargo pallet offload from CLPS-class landers. Phase II completes lunar-thermal vacuum qualification.

awards.title: Distributed Acoustic Sensing for Forward Operating Base Defense
awards.abstract: Dark-fibre acoustic sensing for 24/7 monitoring with anomaly detection tuned to small-UAV and small-arms signatures. Phase II includes 90-day FOB deployment.

awards.title: Federated Learning Across Distributed Maritime Sensors
awards.abstract: Bandwidth-aware federated learning across afloat sensor nodes with rigorous on-platform privacy guarantees. Phase II deploys to a CSG environment.

awards.title: High-Power Hall Thruster for Cislunar Transfer Vehicles
awards.abstract: 20kW Hall-effect thruster cluster qualified for >5,000-hour cislunar duty cycles. Phase II completes life-test article and PCDU integration.

awards.title: Provable Isolation in Mixed-Criticality Spacecraft Compute
awards.abstract: Formally verified separation kernel for next-gen mixed-criticality spacecraft processors. Phase II achieves Common Criteria EAL5+ alignment.

awards.title: Reusable Sub-Orbital Test Bed for Hypersonic Payloads
awards.abstract: Recoverable sub-orbital vehicle for short-cycle hypersonic test campaigns from established commercial spaceports. Phase II completes pathfinder vehicle.

awards.title: Single-Photon LIDAR for Lunar Surface Mapping
awards.abstract: Geiger-mode SPAD array delivering sub-30 cm DEM resolution from CLPS-class landers. Phase II hardens detector for sustained day-night cycles and qualifies for thermal vacuum.

awards.title: Boundary-Layer Ingesting Inlet for Next-Gen Engines
awards.abstract: Distortion-tolerant compressor stages for BLI inlets reducing fuel burn 4–6% on transport-class platforms. Phase II includes wind-tunnel and altitude-rig testing.

awards.title: Counter-UAS Net-Capture Munition for Group 1-2 Threats
awards.abstract: Low-collateral kinetic capture system using deployable net + parachute, integrated with squad-level RWR. Phase II includes live-fire trials at Yuma.

awards.title: Continual Learning for Battlefield Sensor Networks
awards.abstract: Distributed model updates that retain capability under catastrophic-forgetting conditions on tactical edge nodes. Phase II demonstrates against three threat scenarios.

awards.title: Hardware Root-of-Trust for Mission-Critical RTOS
awards.abstract: Tamper-evident attestation chain bound to spacecraft RTOS boot sequence. Phase II demonstrates secure recovery on RAD-tolerant SoCs.

awards.title: AUV-UAV Joint Operations for Littoral Surveillance
awards.abstract: Cross-domain collaborative autonomy for surface and subsurface vehicles operating in degraded comms. Phase II delivers a six-vehicle live demonstration.

awards.title: Free-Space Quantum Key Distribution for SATCOM Links
awards.abstract: Decoy-state BB84 over commercial SATCOM links with field-deployable ground terminals. Phase II demonstrates LEO–ground key exchange under realistic atmospheric conditions.

awards.title: Dual-Mode Bipropellant Engine for Smallsats
awards.abstract: Single chamber switching between high-thrust and high-Isp modes for smallsat orbital insertion + station-keeping. Phase II completes a 50-cycle qualification campaign.

awards.title: Onboard Computer Vision Pipeline for Border Surveillance
awards.abstract: Power-bounded inference stack for fixed-site towers, target classification across 12 threat classes with <0.5% FAR. Phase II includes 90-day field test on the Rio Grande sector.

awards.title: Adaptive Camouflage Material for Optical/IR Spectra
awards.abstract: Electrochromic skin material switching emissivity in-band on millisecond timescales. Phase II tests at platoon-scale on standard tactical vehicles.

awards.title: Generative SAR Augmentation for Limited-Label Training
awards.abstract: Diffusion-based synthetic SAR for rare-target classes (vehicles, vessels, denied-area infra) with quantifiable feature fidelity. Phase II validates on real fleet imagery.

awards.title: Polarisation-Diverse Optical Communication Terminal
awards.abstract: Compact OCT supporting two simultaneous polarisation channels at 100 Gbps for proliferated LEO crosslinks. Phase II delivers a flight-representative ETU.

awards.title: Memory-Safe Bootloader for Spaceflight Avionics
awards.abstract: Rust-based bootloader formally verified to spec for radiation-tolerant SoCs. Phase II completes vendor integration with two commercial flight-software platforms.

awards.title: High-Fidelity Hypersonic CFD on GPU Clusters
awards.abstract: Multi-GPU LES solver for thermo-chemical non-equilibrium hypersonic flows. Phase II delivers operational tool for AFRL hypersonic wind-tunnel correlation.

awards.title: Cryogenic Propellant Boil-Off Reduction Membrane
awards.abstract: Multi-layer thermal-acoustic isolation reducing LH2 boil-off by 60% on long-duration cislunar tugs. Phase II completes a 30-day vacuum-cold test campaign.

awards.title: Modular Open-Architecture Tactical Radio Family
awards.abstract: MOSA-compliant SDR with vendor-swap RF heads, supporting WAR/SINCGARS/MUOS waveforms. Phase II delivers four-radio EMI/EMC qualification.

awards.title: Underwater Multi-Vehicle Path Planning Under Adversarial Comms
awards.abstract: Decentralised path replanning for UUVs under acoustic spoofing and comms denial. Phase II demonstrates with a four-vehicle fleet on Pacific NWT range.

awards.title: Magnetometer Array for Sub-LEO Anomaly Detection
awards.abstract: Distributed quantum-enhanced magnetometer array for rapid detection of anomalous signatures from sub-LEO platforms. Phase II includes balloon-flight technology demonstration.

awards.title: Discrimination Algorithms for Hypersonic Endo/Exo-Atmospheric Targets
awards.abstract: Multi-modal classifier (radar + IR) for endo-/exo-atmospheric hypersonic targets, including penaid discrimination. Phase II delivers integration into existing C2 layer.

awards.title: Federated Inference Across Constellation Compute Nodes
awards.abstract: Bandwidth-bounded federated inference between LEO satellites and ground for persistent EO triage. Phase II demonstrates between three commercial bus partners.
